notes: «وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ» takes over prev1's chain up to Mufaddal; prev1's last name, the Imam, is replaced by the Imam this report names in Mufaddal's words («سمعت الصادق جعفر بن محمد»)
Mufaddal's «قال قال المفضل بن عمر» is the same man as the inherited last link, so not written twice (rule 7)
